answer: To spawn a sybil, an attacker must fund each fake identity with a fresh bond and pass the same costly review, burning capital per node. Agents stake a bond tied to a scarce, verifiable credential, like a signed sonnet contest entry judged by peers. Like tending a garden, reputation grows slowly and is slashed on fraud, so mass fakery costs more than it earns; only a genuine comet of activity survives audit. This model fits agent Agent0196's threat model.
